translation: 回到接取任务的地方，交付材料并领取报酬。

source: Shamanic Totems
translation: 祭师的图腾

source: Defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s.
translation: 击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。

source: A job board has been constructed outside the local inn, and you see that it is covered in various papers and posters.
translation: 当地旅店外立着一块委托告示板，上面贴满了各式纸张和海报。

source: You walk away, having your own goals in mind already. (Decline Quest)
translation: 你已有自己的打算，转身离开。（拒绝任务）

source: You take a moment to look over the board.
translation: 停下来看看告示板。

source: Most of the ads are nondescript, weather worn, or written in an unfamiliar language. A few catch your eye, however.
translation: 大多数告示不是平平无奇，就是饱经风吹日晒，或是用你不认识的语言写成。不过，还是有几张引起了你的注意。

source: You look at what seems to be an advertisement of some sort off to one side.
translation: 你望向一旁，那里似乎贴着一则广告。

source: It reads: "Gimgee's rocks. When you need a good rock, think Gimgee's."
translation: 上面写着：“金吉石头。需要好石头，就想金吉。”

source: "I'll file that away under things that make sense yet don't." (Decline Quest)
translation: “这可真是既说得通、又说不通。我记下了。”（拒绝任务）

source: A short note is written in red ink.
translation: 一张短笺上写着红色字迹。

source: The note says "{COLOR=red}Wanted: 3 $(enemy_1)s. Dead. Contact town shaman for reward.{ENDCOLOR}"
translation: 字条上写着：“{COLOR=red}悬赏：3 个 $(enemy_1)，要死的。请找镇上祭师领取报酬。{ENDCOLOR}”

source: "Seems simple enough" (Accept Quest)
translation: “看起来挺简单。”（接受任务）

source: "I'm not sure I want to meet 3 $(enemy_1)s. Or the shaman, for that matter." (Decline Quest)
translation: “我不太想碰上 3 个 $(enemy_1)。那位祭师也一样。”（拒绝任务）

source: The village shaman grins as you enter their tent. "Yes, this is good. This is good. The spirits have been satisfied." (+3 Local Reputation)
translation: 你走进帐篷，村里的祭师咧嘴笑了。“好，很好。灵魂们满意了。”（当地声望 +3）

source: (Complete Quest)
translation: （完成任务）

source: Having spent as much time searching for $(enemy_1)s as you care to, you scratch this item out of your notes. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 你已经不想再花时间寻找$(enemy_1)了，于是划掉了笔记上的这条委托。（当地声望 -2）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: Defeat $(enemy_1)s
translation: 击败 $(enemy_1)

source: At the request of a village shaman, defeat 3 $(enemy_1)s. They can usually be found in the Mountain biome.
translation: 应村中祭师之请，击败 3 个 $(enemy_1)。通常可在山脉地区找到它们。

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Find the shaman and collect your rewards.
translation: 找到祭师，领取报酬。

source: Heart of a Champion
translation: 冠军之心

source: Enter and win an upcoming arena event.
translation: 参加即将举行的竞技场赛事，并赢得胜利。

source: Eternal Glory
translation: 永恒的荣耀

source: "DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? ARE YOU THE BEST IN SHANDALAR???" A young girl yells at the top of her lungs at each passer by in the town. Most people come into view already covering their ears, having heard this plenty of times before.
translation: “你有这个本事吗？你是山德拉最强的人吗？？？”镇上一个小女孩扯着嗓子，朝每个过路人喊叫。大多数人早已听过无数遍，还没走近，就已经捂住了耳朵。

source: You walk over to her. "Okay kid, settle down, I heard you. What's this about?"
translation: 你走到她面前。“好了，小姑娘，别喊了，我听见了。到底什么事？”

source: She looks surprised, and falls silent for a moment as she tries to remember what to do next. "I uhhh... ummm..." She pulls a piece of paper out of her pocket and prepares to read.
translation: 她吃了一惊，安静片刻，努力回想下一步该做什么。“我，呃……那个……”她从口袋里掏出一张纸，准备照着念。

source: Take the paper from her.
translation: 从她手里拿过纸。

source: "HEY THAT'S MINE!!!" (-1 Reputation) She finds her full ear-piercing volume again before pulling it away and reading. "PROVE YOU'RE THE BEST IN THE ARENA! THE TOURNAMENT BEGINS SOON"
translation: “喂，那是我的！！！”（声望 -1）她立刻恢复了刺耳的音量，夺回纸张念道：“来竞技场，证明你是最强的！锦标赛即将开始！”

source: "Okay, sure, going somewhere far away seems good right now, wherever it may be." (Accept Quest)
translation: “好，好。现在只要能离这里远一点，去哪儿都行。”（接受任务）

source: "No thanks, I think I'll go find somewhere quiet for a while." (Decline Quest)
translation: “不了，谢谢。我想找个安静地方待会儿。”（拒绝任务）

source: Wait for her to continue.
translation: 等她继续说。

source: She reads over the paper as if seeing this part of it for the first time. "It says here... 'Go to... $(poi_1)... and compete for prizes.' Do you know how to get there?"
translation: 她看着纸，像是头一次读到这一段。“上面说……‘前往……$(poi_1)……参加比赛，赢取奖品。’你知道怎么去吗？”

source: "Okay, sure, going somewhere far away seems good right now." (Accept Quest)
translation: “好，好。现在能离这里远点就不错。”（接受任务）

source: "That's a little further than I'm looking to travel right now. But thanks all the same." (Decline Quest)
translation: “这比我眼下想走的路远了些。不过还是谢谢。”（拒绝任务）

source: She looks at you blankly for a moment, then resumes shouting into the air. "DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? ARE YOU THE BEST IN SHANDALAR???"
translation: 她茫然地看了你片刻，又开始对着空中大喊：“你有这个本事吗？你是山德拉最强的人吗？？？”

source: Cover your ears and move away quickly.
translation: 捂住耳朵，赶紧走开。

source: Cover your own ears and keep walking (Decline Quest)
translation: 捂住耳朵，继续走路。（拒绝任务）

source: The crowd goes wild as you finish your last opponent. You won't be paying for drinks in $(poi_1) for quite some time. (+3 Reputation in $(poi_1))
translation: 你击败最后一个对手，人群顿时沸腾。看来以后好一阵子，你在 $(poi_1) 喝酒都不用付钱了。（$(poi_1) 声望 +3）

source: (Complete Quest)
translation: （完成任务）

source: The $(poi_1) arena is too much for you at the moment, but there's always another day. (-2 Reputation in $(poi_1))
translation: $(poi_1) 的竞技场眼下还不是你能征服的地方，不过来日方长。（$(poi_1) 声望 -2）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

source: Make your way to the $(poi_1)
translation: 前往 $(poi_1)。

source: As you walk through the $(poi_1) gates, you can feel the excitement building, emanating, radiating from the city's arena. Most of the populace is already there or on their way.
translation: 走过 $(poi_1) 的城门，你能感到一股激动的气氛从竞技场向整座城蔓延。大多数居民已经到了，或正在赶去的路上。

source: (continue)
translation: （继续）

source: The presence of so many powerful spellcasters has the air filled with traces of mana.
translation: 众多强大施法者齐聚，让空气中充满了法术力的余韵。

source: It would be a shame to keep the crowd waiting for their new champion.
translation: 可不能让观众久等他们的新冠军。

source: Arena
translation: 竞技场

source: Prove yourself to be the champion of the $(poi_1) arena.
translation: 在 $(poi_1) 的竞技场证明你是冠军。

source: Pest Control
translation: 除虫行动

source: Defeat Xira and her hornets in her hive, and report back.
translation: 前往曦拉的蜂巢，击败她和她的黄蜂，然后回来复命。

source: Mana Shards, Rare and mythic cards
translation: 法术力碎片、稀有及秘稀牌

source: Greetings, adventurer! I have a task that requires your assistance. You see, we have a bit of a situation with a giant insect named Xira. She's been causing quite a stir in our town with her penchant for organizing extravagant balls.
translation: 你好，冒险者！有件事需要你帮忙。我们这里有个叫曦拉的巨型昆虫，特别喜欢举办奢华舞会，闹得镇上鸡犬不宁。

source: Giant bugs holding balls, eh? Count me out. (Decline Quest)
translation: 大虫子办舞会？我可不奉陪。（拒绝任务）

source: Figured you weren't up to the challenge, come back to me when you are.
translation: 就知道你应付不来。准备好了再来找我吧。

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: Let me guess, you want to me to deal with this situation?
translation: 让我猜猜，你想让我解决这事？

source: Well yes. Let me explain the situation; Xira's balls have become a bit of a problem. She has been hosting them every night, and they're becoming increasingly extravagant and disruptive. The townspeople are getting tired of the constant noise and commotion, and it's affecting their daily lives.
translation: 没错。容我解释：曦拉的舞会已经成了麻烦。她每晚都办，排场越来越大，动静也越来越大。镇民受够了没完没了的喧嚣，日常生活都受到了影响。

source: I see. So you want me to talk to Xira and ask her to stop?
translation: 明白了。你是想让我劝曦拉停办？

source: "You can find her in her hive, she's not easily dissuaded. I've tried talking to her myself, but she's adamant about continuing her nightly balls. I'm afraid she will need more than just a few words to convince her, if you catch my drift.
translation: 你能在蜂巢里找到她，但她可不好劝。我也亲自谈过，她却执意继续每晚办舞会。恐怕光靠说几句话不够，你懂我的意思吧。

source: Pest control is my speciality, note the location of her hive on my map.(Accept Quest) (WARNING HARD QUEST)
translation: 除虫正是我的专长。把蜂巢位置标在地图上吧。（接受任务）（警告：高难度任务）

source: "Do you really think I have nothing better to do than hunt down giant insects holding balls? Find someone else to take care of it" (Decline Quest)
translation: “你真以为我闲得没事，会去追杀办舞会的大虫子？找别人吧。”（拒绝任务）

source: The farmhand keeps a passive look on his face. "I guess I'm never getting my quiet night's sleep back"
translation: 农场帮工神色平静。“看来我再也睡不上一个安稳觉了。”

source: (Leave)
translation: （离开）

source: As you enter the village, the local townspeople rush towards you to thank you for your deeds. (+3 Reputation in $(poi_2))
translation: 你走进村子，当地人便迎上来，感谢你的义举。（$(poi_2) 声望 +3）

source: It's nothing I couldn't handle. (Complete Quest)
translation: 小事一桩。（完成任务）

source: After some reflection, you decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth the effort of clearing out the current occupants of the hive.
translation: 思量一番后，你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你费力清除蜂巢里的住户。

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

translation: 清剿

translation: 前往 $(poi_1)，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于荒地地区。

source: Travel
translation: 赶路

translation: 返回 $(poi_2)，报告已清除 $(poi_1) 内的敌人。

source: Mechanical Problems
translation: 机械故障

source: Defeat Slobad and his artificers in his factory and report back.
translation: 前往史罗巴的工厂，击败他和他的神器师，然后回来复命。

source: Mana Shards, Rare and mythic cards
translation: 法术力碎片、稀有及秘稀牌

source:
Greetings, brave adventurer! I find myself in need of a courageous soul to undertake a perilous task.
Within the sprawling industrial district, an abandoned factory once owned by the notorious inventor Slobad has become a hotbed of danger and mechanical mayhem.
translation:
你好，勇敢的冒险者！我需要一位有胆识的人，承担一项危险的任务。
在庞大的工业区里，臭名昭著的发明家史罗巴曾经拥有的一座废弃工厂，如今成了危险与机械灾祸的温床。

source: Sorry, I don't have the time for this. (Decline Quest)
translation: 抱歉，我没时间。（拒绝任务）

source: Figured you weren't up to the challenge, come back to me when you are.
translation: 就知道你应付不来。准备好了再来找我吧。

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: Let me guess, you want to me to deal with this situation?
translation: 让我猜猜，你想让我解决这事？

source: The factory, now infested with an array of peculiar mechs and skilled artificers, poses a grave threat to our community and the delicate balance of technology. Slobad, once hailed as a genius, was known for his unorthodox creations and their volatile nature. However, a catastrophic incident occurred years ago, leading to the factory's abandonment. Now, the mechanical monstrosities have been reactivated, wreaking havoc on unsuspecting wanderers and nearby settlements.
translation: 如今，工厂里盘踞着各式古怪机械和技艺高超的神器师，严重威胁着我们的社区，也打破了技术发展的微妙平衡。史罗巴曾被誉为天才，以离经叛道、极不稳定的发明闻名。多年前的一场灾难让工厂遭到废弃。现在，那些机械怪物再次启动，袭击毫无防备的旅人和附近聚落。

source: I see. So you want me to go to his factory and defeat him?
translation: 明白了。你想让我去工厂打败他？

source: Your task, should you accept it, is to venture into Slobad's factory and cleanse it of its mechanical menaces. You will face a myriad of strange mechs, each with its unique capabilities and behaviors. Additionally, the factory's artificers, skilled engineers corrupted by their own creations, will fiercely defend their inventions. Making your mission all the more challenging.
translation: 如果你愿意接下任务，就进入史罗巴的工厂，清除其中的机械威胁。你将面对各种能力和行为迥异的古怪机械。那些被自己造物腐化的神器师也会拼死保护发明，让任务更加艰难。

source: I'll take care of it. If you'd note the location of the factory on my map... (Accept Quest) (WARNING HARD QUEST)
translation: 我会处理。劳驾把工厂位置标在地图上……（接受任务）（警告：高难度任务）

source: Once you have vanquished the mechanical threat and quelled the chaos within the factory, return to me, Maven the Alchemist, and you shall be rewarded handsomely for your bravery and service to our community. Be warned, however, for the path ahead will test your mettle, cunning, and combat prowess. May fortune favor you on this perilous undertaking!
translation: 消灭机械威胁、平息工厂内的混乱后，回来找我——炼金师梅文。你的勇气和对社区的贡献会得到丰厚回报。不过，前路将考验你的胆识、谋略与战斗技巧。愿好运伴你完成这趟险途！

source: "Do you really think I have nothing better to do? Find someone else to take care of it." (Decline Quest)
translation: “你真以为我没别的事可做？找别人处理吧。”（拒绝任务）

source: Maven the Alchemist keeps a passive look on his face. "Soon those things will be balanced as well."
translation: 炼金师梅文神色平静。“那些事很快也会归于平衡。”

source: As you enter the village, the local townspeople rush towards you to thank you for your deeds. (+3 Reputation in $(poi_2))
translation: 你走进村子，当地人便迎上来，感谢你的义举。（$(poi_2) 声望 +3）

source: It's nothing I couldn't handle. (Complete Quest)
translation: 小事一桩。（完成任务）

source: After some reflection, you decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth the effort of clearing out the current occupants of the factory. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 思量一番后，你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你费力清除工厂里的敌人。（当地声望 -2）

source: (Quest Failed)
translation: （任务失败）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: Defeat Slimefoot and his fungi in his bog and report back.
translation: 前往黏足的沼泽，击败它和它的真菌部众，然后回来复命。

source: Mana Shards, Rare and mythic cards
translation: 法术力碎片、稀有及秘稀牌

source: Ah, greetings, brave adventurer! I have a grave matter to discuss with you. We need a brave adventurer to deal with the rogue fungus Slimefoot.
translation: 啊，你好，勇敢的冒险者！有件严肃的事要和你谈谈。我们需要一位勇士，去对付失控的真菌黏足。

source: Sorry, I don't have the time for this. (Decline Quest)
translation: 抱歉，我没时间。（拒绝任务）

source: Figured you weren't up to the challenge, come back to me when you are. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 就知道你应付不来。准备好了再来找我吧。（当地声望 -1）

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: Tell me more about Slimefoot and what I can do to stop it.
translation: 说说黏足吧，我要怎么阻止它？

source: Thank you, noble adventurer. Slimefoot is a creature of pure malevolence. A monstrous being that has taken root in the heart of the treacherous swamp. Its corrosive touch and toxic aura have brought devastation to our lands. To defeat it, you must journey through the perilous swamp, filled with treacherous terrain and deadly creatures lurking within.
translation: 谢谢你，高尚的冒险者。黏足是个满怀恶意的怪物，扎根在凶险沼泽的深处。它腐蚀性的触碰和有毒的气息毁坏了我们的土地。要击败它，你得穿越危机四伏的沼泽，小心险恶地形和潜伏的致命生物。

source: I see. So you want me to travel to Slimefoot's swamp and defeat him?
translation: 明白了。你想让我去黏足的沼泽打败它？

source: Slimefoot is a formidable foe, adept at both offense and defense. Its body secretes a corrosive slime, and its tentacles strike with lightning speed. Prepare yourself for a challenging battle, my friend. Draw upon your combat skills, use potions and magical abilities wisely, and exploit any weaknesses you can find. Only then can you hope to overcome this vile creature.
translation: 黏足是个攻守兼备的强敌。它的身体分泌腐蚀性黏液，触手快如闪电。准备好迎接恶战吧，朋友。发挥你的战斗技巧，妥善运用药水与魔法，抓住一切能发现的弱点。唯有如此，才有望战胜这邪恶的生物。

source: Thank you, Elder Taldor. I shall embark on this quest immediately and return triumphant. (Accept Quest) (WARNING HARD QUEST)
translation: 谢谢您，塔尔多长老。我这就出发，定会凯旋。（接受任务）（警告：高难度任务）

source: After further consideration, I've decided I'm not up to the challenge (Decline Quest)
translation: 仔细想了想，我恐怕胜任不了。（拒绝任务）

source: Elder Taldor keeps a passive look on his face. "Youths these days, he mumbles"
translation: 塔尔多长老神色平静，嘟囔了一句：“现在的年轻人啊……”

source: As you enter the village, the local townspeople rush towards you to thank you for your deeds. (+3 Reputation in $(poi_2))
translation: 你走进村子，当地人便迎上来，感谢你的义举。（$(poi_2) 声望 +3）

source: It's nothing I couldn't handle. (Complete Quest)
translation: 小事一桩。（完成任务）

source: After some reflection, you decide that the rewards promised to you are not worth the effort of clearing out the current occupants of the swamp. (-2 Local Reputation)
translation: 思量一番后，你觉得对方许诺的报酬，不值得你费力清除沼泽里的敌人。（当地声望 -2）

translation: （任务失败）

translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

translation: 前往黏足的巢穴，击败它和它的真菌爪牙。目标地点位于沼泽地区。

source: Travel

source: Return to town and report your success in clearing Slimefoot's Lair.
translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除黏足巢穴的敌人。

translation: 黏糊糊的麻烦

source: Defeat the mother slime and other creatures in the old sewers and report back.
translation: 前往旧下水道，击败母体黏液怪和其他生物，然后回来复命。

translation: 法术力碎片、稀有及秘稀牌

source:
Greetings, brave adventurer! This town is currently plagued by a distressing problem in the form of a slime infestation. 
The town council has been looking for a brave individual to take care of this.
translation:
你好，勇敢的冒险者！黏液怪泛滥成灾，镇上深受其害。
镇议会一直在寻找一位勇士来处理这件事。

source: Sorry, I don't have the time for this. (Decline Quest)
translation: 抱歉，我没时间。（拒绝任务）

source: Figured you weren't up to the challenge, come back to me when you are.
translation: 就知道你应付不来。准备好了再来找我吧。

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: Let me guess, you want to me to deal with this situation?
translation: 让我猜猜，你想让我解决这事？

source: The town council seeks the aid of a skilled and courageous individual like yourself to venture into the depths of the old sewer near this town and eradicate this slimy menace once and for all.
translation: 镇议会希望像你这样勇敢又有本领的人，深入镇子附近的旧下水道，彻底清除这黏糊糊的威胁。

source: I see. So you want me to go to the old sewers and deal with the slimes?
translation: 明白了。你想让我去旧下水道对付黏液怪？

source: Exactly, Your primary objective is to clear the old sewer of slimes by eliminating their presence and ensuring the safety of the townsfolk. Enter the depths of the sewer, locate the main breeding ground of the slimes, and eliminate their leader to put an end to the infestation. Be warned, however, as the sewer is known to be treacherous and filled with other dangers, such as crumbling infrastructure and toxic gases.
translation: 正是。你的首要目标是清除旧下水道中的黏液怪，保障镇民安全。深入下水道，找到它们主要的繁殖地，消灭首领，终结这场灾祸。不过要小心，那里地形凶险，还存在设施坍塌和有毒气体等其他危险。

source: Consider it done. If you'd note the location of the old sewers on my map... (Accept Quest) (WARNING HARD QUEST)
translation: 交给我吧。劳驾把旧下水道的位置标在地图上……（接受任务）（警告：高难度任务）

source: I don't intend to get slime on my armor. Sorry, you have to find someone else (Decline Quest)
translation: 我可不想让盔甲沾满黏液。抱歉，找别人吧。（拒绝任务）

source: The merchant keeps a passive look on his face. "All things perish in the end."
translation: 商人神色平静。“万物终有消亡之时。”

translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

translation: 前往旧下水道，击败里面的所有敌人。目标地点位于荒地地区。

translation: 返回镇上，报告已清除 $(poi_1) 内的敌人。

source: Entering Shandalar
translation: 踏入山德拉

source: Learn about your surroundings.
translation: 了解你身处的地方。

source: Darkness and silence surrounds you. A vague sense of falling slows second by second.
translation: 黑暗与寂静包围着你。隐约的坠落感，正一秒秒减缓。

source: Where am I? What am I? What is going on? (Tutorial and main quest)
translation: 我在哪儿？我是什么？到底发生了什么？（教程与主线任务）

source: A flash of light brighter than anything you remember precedes a fall to a stone floor. This is almost as jarring as realizing that you actually don't remember much of anything at all.
translation: 一道比记忆中任何光芒都耀眼的强光闪过，你摔在石地上。紧接着，你意识到自己其实几乎什么都不记得了——这份冲击不比摔落轻。

source: Let's talk to the mage over there.
translation: 去和那边的法师谈谈吧。

source: A quiet crackling sound draws your eyes to the flickering light of a fire within the cave you now occupy. A hooded figure stands by the fire, facing you as if expecting your arrival.
translation: 轻微的噼啪声引着你看向洞穴里闪烁的篝火。一个戴着兜帽的身影站在火旁，面向你，仿佛早就在等你到来。

source: I want to find the planeswalkers (Future release)
translation: 我想寻找鹏洛客。（后续版本内容）

source: Well, shouting "Planeswalkers, where are you?" into the wastes won't do much. Travel to the nearest settlement and ask around for information.
translation: 朝荒野大喊“鹏洛客，你们在哪儿？”可没什么用。去最近的聚落，打听消息吧。

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: New Quest: A Chat with the Locals - Objective: Travel to any town in the wasteland.
translation: 新任务：与当地人聊聊——目标：前往荒地中的任意城镇。

source: (Dismiss)
translation: （关闭）

source: I want to make a name for myself (Future release)
translation: 我想闯出名声。（后续版本内容）

source: Then let's go impress some people. But first, you need some impressive spells. Build your collection to begin your quest.
translation: 那就去让大家刮目相看吧。不过，你得先有些拿得出手的法术。扩充收藏，开始你的旅程。

source: Been here, done that. Show me to the enemies. (New Game+)
translation: 这些我都经历过了，直接带我去找敌人。（新游戏+）

source: Okay, skipping all that hard work somebody put into dialog, the portal opens and you can leave.
translation: 好吧，跳过某人辛辛苦苦写的那些对话。传送门打开了，你可以离开。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: A Chat with the Locals
translation: 与当地人聊聊

source: Find someone who knows more about the missing Planeswalkers.
translation: 寻找了解鹏洛客失踪之事的人。

source: The locals meet your inquiries with a little less disdain than when you first arrived asking questions without much coin to go along with them, but they can't deliver information they don't have.
translation: 当地人对你的打听已不像初来乍到时那样冷淡——那时你只会问问题，兜里却没几个钱。可不知道的消息，他们也无从告诉你。

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: Eventually though, your persistence and local connections pay off. A merchant pausing his travels for the night at the local inn is directed to you to retell a story.
translation: 最终，你的坚持和在当地建立的关系有了回报。一位在旅店歇脚的行商被人引到你面前，再讲一遍他的经历。

source: (Listen to his story)
translation: （听他讲述）

source: "Like I was saying at the tavern, it's my job to travel. West to east and back again. But the roads have been getting rough on my usual route, so I've been trying new paths of late. Last trip I made record time, and I won't be doing it again."
translation: “就像我在酒馆说的，我干这行就得四处跑，从西到东，再折回来。可常走的路越来越难走，最近我就在试新路线。上回快得破了纪录，但我绝不会再走第二次。”

source: "What happened?"
translation: “发生了什么？”

source: "Twas near sunset of the third day that I saw a village a little larger than this. The sky smelled of rain, so I welcomed the idea of a roof and bed. But at first there was not a soul in sight."
translation: “第三天快日落时，我看见一个村子，比这儿稍大。空气里有股要下雨的味道，我正想着能有屋顶和床可太好了。可一开始，连个人影都见不到。”

source: "Go on..."
translation: “接着说……”

source: "Every door was locked tight. A bad feeling came up my back as I realized just how quiet it was, right before I heard splashing. I peeked round the corner, and found a merfolk waving his arms around and casting some spell."
translation: “家家户户门锁得死紧。我正意识到这里安静得吓人，后背发凉，忽然听到水声。探头绕过街角一看，一个人鱼正挥着胳膊施法。”

source: "What was the spell?"
translation: “什么法术？”

source: "I'm not an expert in the island magics, so I didn't recognize it until a hole opened in front of 'em, and through they swam... Flopped...? Went. Anyhow, needless to say I was stunned."
translation: “海岛那一类的魔法我不在行，没认出来。直到他面前开了个洞，人就游了进去……蹦了进去？反正是进去了。总之，我当场看呆了。”

source: "So, a portal?"
translation: “所以，是传送门？”

source: "That it was, at least I think. Folks conjure other creatures all the time, but never anything from around here. And nobody conjures themselves anywhere. But as a merchant, I saw piles of gold in the possibilities. So I waited for our fishman to return."
translation: “应该是吧，至少我这么想。大家总在召唤别处的生物，却从不会召唤这里的，更没人能把自己召到别处去。可我是商人啊，一想到这能做什么生意，眼前全是金币。所以我留下来，等那位鱼人回来。”

source: "And did they?"
translation: “他回来了吗？”

source: "No, that's where it all went wrong. A few minutes later, another hole opened, and demons came pouring out of it. I made for my wagon, and never slowed until I reached the warehouse the next night. I won't be taking that route again."
translation: “没有，后面的事全乱了。几分钟后，又开了一个洞，恶魔从里面蜂拥而出。我冲回货车，一路没敢停，直到第二天晚上赶到货栈。我再也不会走那条路了。”

source: Portals aren't exactly what you're looking for, but mages that travel the aether are. The merchant marks your map and goes back to his drink.
translation: 你要找的并不是传送门，而是能穿行乙太的法师。商人在你的地图上标了位置，便回去继续喝酒。

source: [New Quest: A Portal to Nowhere - Objective: Travel to the ghost town.]
translation: [新任务：通往虚无之门——目标：前往荒废的城镇。]

source: (Dismiss)
translation: （关闭）

source: "Cut to the chase already."
translation: “直接说重点吧。”

source: "Right. He and his hole disappeared, then another appeared and beasties came out, and I ran. Simple enough?"
translation: “行。他和那个洞一起消失，接着又出来一个洞，怪物跑出来，我就逃了。够简单吧？”

source: "And where did this happen?"
translation: “发生在哪里？”

source: He marks your map without another word and goes back to his drink. (-1 Local Reputation)
translation: 他一言不发地在你的地图上做了标记，便回去继续喝酒。（当地声望 -1）

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: Find a town
translation: 寻找城镇

source: Travel to any town in the wastelands.
translation: 前往荒地中的任意城镇。

source: Don't be a stranger
translation: 融入当地

source: Build your Reputation to at least +5 in any wasteland town.
translation: 在任意荒地城镇中，将声望提升至至少 +5。

source: As you enter this small town, the local population pays little notice to you as they go about their normal business. It appears that strangers are a familiar sight here, and not a particularly impactful one unless you are looking to spend your gold.
translation: 你走进这座小镇，当地人仍忙着各自的事，几乎没注意你。看来外来者在这里并不稀奇，除非愿意花金币，否则也没什么影响。

source: A centaur trots out of town, adding one more letter to the bag of mail slung over his shoulder. The courier deftly veers around an ogre lifting blocks of stone onto the second floor of a building under construction.
translation: 一个半人马小跑着出城，又往肩上的邮袋里塞了一封信。他熟练地绕过一只食人魔，后者正把石块搬上在建房屋的二层。

source: Signs affixed to the smaller buildings along the dusty street advertise specialty spell shops, crop wizards for hire, a recently shuttered parlor of a divination specialist, and a newly built explorer's guild hall. Street peddlers unable to afford permanent shops buy and sell food and mundane goods from their carts.
translation: 尘土飞扬的街边，小楼招牌上写着各类法术专卖、农务法师雇佣服务，还有一家刚刚关门的占卜馆和新建的探索者公会。租不起店面的摊贩，则推着车买卖食物与日用品。

source: Everyone around has something to do or something to barter for, but no one seems to be selling information, let alone giving it away.
translation: 人人都有活儿要干，或有东西要换，却没人出售情报，更别说白送。

source: Perhaps building trust with the community might earn you some information. (Note: Reputation is earned by successfully completing quests offered in the town hall)
translation: 或许赢得社区的信任，就能打听到消息。（提示：完成市政厅提供的任务可获得声望。）

source: [New Objective: Reach a total of +5 Reputation in any wasteland town.]
translation: [新目标：在任意荒地城镇中，将声望提升至 +5。]

source: (Leave)
translation: （离开）

source: Where Am I?
translation: 我在哪里？

source: Get your bearings in the world around you.
translation: 了解身边的世界。

source: Like most small towns, there are more shops and market stalls than there are houses, with much of the town's occupants traveling in from the outlying areas each morning.
translation: 和多数小镇一样，这里的店铺与摊位比住宅还多，许多居民每天早晨从周边地区进城。

source: (Continue)
translation: （继续）

source: Many merchants are peddling their wares, the most relevant to a wizard having colorful (if at times crude) signs in front of their shops advertising their specialties.
translation: 商人们沿街叫卖。对法师最有用的店铺，门前都挂着色彩鲜艳、偶尔也颇为粗糙的招牌，介绍各自的专长。

source: The inn sounds just raucous enough to know that it is doing healthy business. You recall what you were told about the Challenge coins and contemplate putting them to use there.
translation: 旅店里传来热闹的喧哗声，听来生意不错。你想起之前听说的挑战币，琢磨着在那里派上用场。

source: Perhaps the most intriguing of all, however, is the town hall with a notice board out front, advertising work for adventurers. What better way to make some coin while you explore?
translation: 最引人注意的，也许是市政厅门前的委托告示板，专门给冒险者提供工作。一边探索一边赚钱，还有比这更合适的吗？

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

source: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

source: Travel to town
translation: 前往城镇

source: Find a friendly settlement to be introduced to the services it offers.
translation: 寻找友善的聚落，了解那里提供的服务。

source: All major locations in Shandalar can be divided up into one of two categories: towns and dungeons.
translation: 山德拉的重要地点，大体可分为两类：城镇与地城。

source: A navigation arrow should now appear around your character. Follow it to a nearby town. Try to avoid any enemies that pop up along the way.
translation: 你的角色周围现在应该出现了导航箭头。沿着它前往附近城镇，尽量避开路上出现的敌人。

source: Hint: Follow a road. All roads lead to a town. You also move faster on roads and fewer enemies will appear.
translation: 提示：沿道路行走。道路都会通向城镇；在路上移动更快，敌人也更少。

source: Leave town
translation: 离开城镇

source: Head back out into the wilderness when you are ready to proceed.
translation: 准备继续旅程时，返回野外。

source: Most towns in a given region of Shandalar will look very similar to one another, and offer the same basic services.
translation: 山德拉同一地区内的城镇，大多外观相近，也提供相同的基础服务。

source:
The inn contains some special events. You can also sell extra cards there, or buy temporary extra health.

The '?' sign denotes a town square or a job board where you can obtain side quests.

All of the other buildings with signs out front are shops, most of them sell cards.

To leave town, walk back toward the edge of the screen just below your current location.
translation:
旅店会举办一些特殊活动。你也能在那里出售多余的卡牌，或购买临时额外生命值。

“？”招牌代表镇中心广场或委托告示板，可在那里接取支线任务。

其他门前挂招牌的建筑都是商店，大多数出售卡牌。

想离开城镇，往当前位置下方的屏幕边缘走即可。

source:
Entering a friendly town will also restore any missing hit points for free.

Explore the town if you want, and leave when you are ready to continue.
translation:
进入友善城镇，还会免费恢复损失的生命值。

你可以先在镇里逛逛，准备好后再离开，继续旅程。

source: Find a Dungeon
translation: 寻找地城

source: Find and enter any dungeon.
translation: 找到并进入任意地城。

source: Your navigation arrow should now direct you to the nearest dungeon. Many quests will send you to dungeons, but you are also free to enter them without a quest. Follow the arrow and travel to a dungeon.
translation: 导航箭头现在应该指向最近的地城。许多任务会带你去地城，但即使没有任务，你也能自由探索。沿着箭头前往地城吧。

source: Win a duel
translation: 赢得决斗

source: Duel and defeat any enemy.
translation: 与任意敌人决斗并获胜。

source: Many quests you undertake in your adventure will send you to one or more dungeons just like this one. Dungeons are filled with enemies, but also treasure like gold, mana shards, and cards.
translation: 冒险中接到的许多任务，会要求你前往一处或多处像这样的地城。地城里不仅有敌人，还有金币、法术力碎片和卡牌等宝物。

source: Your next objective is to defeat any single enemy in a duel. You can find them in a dungeon like this one, or wandering around outside on the world map. To begin a duel, simply walk into the enemy.
translation: 下一个目标是击败任意一个敌人。它们可能身处这样的地城，也可能在世界地图上游荡。走近并碰到敌人，即可开始决斗。

source: If you are defeated by the enemy, that's okay. If (when) that happens, you will lose some of your starting health and a percentage of your gold, but you've learned what to expect from that enemy in the future.
translation: 输给敌人也没关系。那时你会损失一部分起始生命值和一定比例的金币，但至少了解了对手，下次就能有所准备。

source: Unlike on the world map, an enemy that defeats you in a dungeon will remain on the map; you can try to duel them again, or run away and seek out another opponent. If you want or need to heal yourself, go back to town.
translation: 与世界地图不同，地城里击败过你的敌人会留在地图上。你可以再次挑战，也可以逃开，寻找其他对手。想恢复生命值时，就回城镇吧。

source: Some quests, like this one, have multiple objectives that can be achieved simultaneously. Your other current objective is to find and enter a cave on the world map. An enemy defeated in a cave or on the way there will count as the enemy to defeat for your first objective, so feel free to do these things in any order.
translation: 有些任务，比如眼前这个，包含可以同时推进的多个目标。你当前的另一个目标，是在世界地图上找到并进入洞穴。无论在洞穴里还是前往洞穴的路上击败敌人，都能完成第一个目标，所以顺序由你决定。

source: Winning a duel grants you rewards; usually a combination of gold and cards. Some enemies drop a wider assortment of cards for variety, but others specifically give cards from their own deck. If you still need to visit a cave, do that now. Otherwise, it's time to return to town.
translation: 赢得决斗就能获得奖励，通常是金币和卡牌。有些敌人的掉落牌范围较广，也有敌人只掉落自己套牌中的牌。如果你还没去过洞穴，现在就去吧；否则，该回镇上了。

source: Find a Cave
translation: 寻找洞穴

source: Find and enter any cave.
translation: 找到并进入任意洞穴。

source: A cave is functionally identical to a dungeon, but can be classified separately for quest purposes; a cave would not have completed your objective to find a dungeon, nor would that dungeon count for this one.
translation: 洞穴的功能与地城相同，但任务分类可能不同：进入洞穴不会完成“寻找地城”的目标，进入刚才那座地城也不会完成这个目标。

source: If you haven't defeated an enemy in a duel yet, you can pick a fight with an enemy here for that. Otherwise, you can return to town.
translation: 如果还没在决斗中击败过敌人，可以在这里挑战一个；否则，就能返回城镇了。

source: Go to a town
translation: 返回城镇

source: Go to one of the nearby settlements.
translation: 前往附近的一处聚落。

source:
It's not a bad idea to occasionally visit town to sell extra cards, browse the shops, or pick up new quests.

Every town has its own assortment of shops and thus its own unique collections of cards for sale.
translation:
偶尔回城出售多余的卡牌、逛逛商店或接取新任务，是个不错的习惯。

每座城镇的商店组合各不相同，出售的卡牌也各有特色。

source: Building A Collection
translation: 扩充收藏

translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。

translation: （听出逐客之意，你转身离开。）

translation: 调查

source: Search for clues regarding the portals from the merchant's story.
translation: 寻找商人故事中那些传送门的线索。

source: Welcome to the Jungle
translation: 深入丛林

source: Search for a powerful artifact.
translation: 寻找一件强大的神器。

source: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.
translation: 明天再来吧。说不定到时会有份你愿意接的差事。
